items.title: Show HN: Bugsy – AI automation which runs my company
items.contentSnippet:
It started as a simple sentry ai triager and grew into a system which powers a lot of day-to-day operations in our company (~20 people).
We use it for reporting and fixing bugs, code review, metrics, answer all kinds of questions and it is available from slack and our forum and channels. 
It is now such a big part of our life that I decided to map it out and share.

items.title: Show HN: RealtimeVAD – trading false positives for 110ms earlier end-of-speech
items.contentSnippet:
Hey guys. I recently watched the latency reports for my local voice assistant, which show a waveform plus silero probability for voice activity. I noticed silero lags visibly on the speech off signal.
There had to be a method to get this signal closer to what I felt is optimal. My idea was to use a 10 ms energy detector with a threshold that adapts to environment or room noise. items.contentSnippet:
